name: 9 Miles East Farm Meal Subscription Service
tagline: Subscription Meal Delivery — 9 Miles East Farm
description: 9 Miles East Farm Meal Subscription Service is a CSA (community-supported agriculture) farm in 136 Goff Road, NY. Members receive a season-long share of the farm's harvest, supporting local growing while getting fresh, seasonal produce. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Availability follows the local growing season, so what is on offer changes through the year.
